definition.simple: A perfect mixture where one thing is completely dissolved in another.
definition.academic: A homogeneous mixture of two or more substances, typically a solute dissolved in a solvent.

common_misconceptions: Solutions are always liquids. (Fact: Solid solutions like alloys exist!)
ai_context.tutor_hint: Ask the student if a mixture of sand and water is a solution. (No, because sand doesn't dissolve!)
